steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Development is the process of improvement in a country's economic and social conditions. It involves changes in wealth, health, education, and standard of living. | Definition: GNI per head is the total value of goods and services produced by a country in a year, plus income from abroad, divided by the population. It is measured in US dollars. | Key Link: Social and economic indicators are closely connected. Higher GNI means more money for healthcare and education, which leads to lower infant mortality, higher life expectancy, and better literacy rates. | Definition: The HDI is a composite indicator created by the United Nations that combines three measures of development: GNI per head (PPP), life expectancy at birth, and mean years of schooling.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the term 'GNI per head'. | Describe two limitations of using GNI per head as a measure of development. | Explain why the HDI is considered a better measure of development than GNI alone.
